sentences.text:
(1) Madhab Chandra .... Petitioner
 Pradhan & others Mr. Saroj
 Kumar Dash,
 Advocate
 -versus-
 (1) State of Odisha .... Opp. Party
 Mr.B.K.Ragada
 Aga
 Coram:
 Justice Sibo Sankar Mishra
Order Order
 No. 15.05.2024
01. 1.
The petitioner had moved an application U/S. 311 Cr.P.C. seeking recall of P.W.1, who is the victim in the present case.

2. The petitioner is an accused in Special G.R. Case No.100 of 2020 arising out of Ranpur P.S. Case No.245 of 2020 under sections- 363/ 366/ 376(2) (1)(3)/109/34 IPC r/w Sections-4/6/17 of the POCSO Act r/w Sections-9/10/11 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act.

3. In view of the bar contained in Section 33(5) POCSO Act., the application of the petitioner U/S.
311 Cr.P.C. seeking recall of the victim for re- examination as witness has been rightly rejected.
4. I am not inclined to interfere in the matter at this stage.
However, rejection of the present petition shall not preclude the petitioner to lead defence evidence.
(S.S. Mishra) Judge Subhasis Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack.
